XMLDB.COMMENT: Defines the database tables for the local_categoryfields plugin.

TABLE.NAME: local_categoryfields_data
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores extra data for course categories.

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to the course_categories table.

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: Rich text summary for the category card.

FIELD.NAME: imageurl
FIELD.COMMENT: URL for the category card image.
